title: Vueform CLI configuration
description: Configuration for the Vueform CLI (npx vueform).

componentsDir.description: The directory where `vueform copy` places local component copies, relative to the project root.

autoRegister.description: Set to false by `vueform copy` when automatic registration was declined — the CLI won't offer to edit your entry file again. Delete or set to true to re-enable the offer.

postCopy.description: Shell command run once after `vueform copy` writes files, from the project root — use it to format/lint the new copies with your own tooling before their hashes are recorded. `{files}` is replaced with the shell-quoted list of written files; without it the command runs as-is. When unset, the CLI runs your project's prettier over the written files instead (only if prettier is installed and a project config resolves).

copies.description: Provenance of copied components, written by `vueform copy` — the source package, its version, and per-file hashes.

hash.description: Hash of the file as it landed in the project (after formatting settled) — the baseline for modified/conflict checks.

registryHash.description: Hash of the pristine registry source the copy came from.

clones.description: Elements created with `vueform clone` — the base component and blueprint provenance. Clones are your own code: they are never updated or diffed against the registry.

base.description: The element the clone was created from.

type.description: The new element's `type` used in schemas.

hash.description: Hash of the file as it landed in the project (after formatting settled) — the baseline for modified/conflict checks.

registryHash.description: Hash of the pristine registry source the copy came from.
